name: Mom
source:
[url=/c175728]Flynn[/url]'s loving mother. She was a great wife to Flynn's father and an even better parent to him. She raised him pretty much by herself since Flynn's father was always leaving to one dig site or another.. She changed a lot after Flynn's father was gone, but she remained a great parent and raised him well.

[Edited from in-game description]
